Fields.Name: Pad Button
Fields.Description: Default controller button or stick direction of the action. 2900 and 2901 are the two face buttons that follow the system's confirm-button setting: 2900 becomes 2005 and 2901 becomes 2004, the other way round when the setting is reversed.

Fields.Name: Keyboard Modifier Key
Fields.Description: Modifier key held together with Keyboard Key for the action.

Fields.Name: Keyboard Key
Fields.Description: Default keyboard key of the action. -1: none (also skipped by the key configuration's conflict check).

Fields.Name: Mouse Modifier Key
Fields.Description: Modifier key held together with Mouse Button for the action.

Fields.Name: Mouse Button
Fields.Description: Default mouse button or wheel input of the action.

Fields.Name: Name ID
Fields.Description: The name to use for this key assignment.

Fields.Name: Description ID
Fields.Description: The description to use for this key assignment.

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: For pad sticks. Works for both X and Y axes.

Fields.Name: Shared Pad Key
Fields.Description: Pad action shared with this when holding Y/Triangle.
